Team Phoenix barely made the finals. But after hearing Ian’s antagonistic warning, Shawn grows anxious and loses his patience. Shawn wraps up practice sooner than the others and leaves school. Luke, who’s after Skyhawk, ambushes Shawn with his friends. Just then, Ayeon appears and scolds Luke and his friends. He saves Shawn and leaves. Shawn finds Ayeon at the Understreet Stadium and pairs up with him as a team. A free, unlimited Aerover competition ensues - Understreet!
